purpose: Teach: 挙式/原宿/マフィア/マドリード/ハローワーク/フェラーリ/軽井沢/種子

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんとの挙式の写真を見せてあげようね
lines.en: Sho, let me show you the wedding photos with Dad.
lines.style: Warm, inviting tone. Soft opening, a gentle hand-gesture in the voice. Unhurried — she wants him to feel included, not rushed. Eyes crinkling with the memory.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと原宿に行きたいよ
lines.en: Mom, I want to go to Harajuku with Dad.
lines.style: Bright, eager request. Quick pace on the desire. Small-boy enthusiasm — not demanding, but hopeful and direct. A slight lift at the end, seeking approval.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがマフィア映画は子供は観られないって
lines.en: Sho, Dad says you can't watch that mafia movie — you're still too young for it.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but not unkind. Measured pace. She's relaying a boundary gently, not as punishment. A slight apologetic softness underneath — she's on Dad's side but wants Sho to understand it's fair.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとマドリードの絵本読んだよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I read that picture book about Madrid together.
lines.style: Warm, proud recollection. Slower pace than the first request — he's savoring the memory. Gentle emphasis on 'together'. A satisfied smile in his voice, sharing something good that happened.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがハローワーク経由で転職されたのよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad recently changed jobs through the employment center.
lines.style: Calm, informative. No emotion layered on — just sharing news. Steady pace. A subtle undercurrent of quiet pride in how Ryosuke handled the transition, but she's not dwelling on it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとフェラーリの模型を組み立てたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I built a Ferrari model together.
lines.style: Genuine delight, with a note of accomplishment. Unhurried — he's letting the detail sink in. Small pause before 'Ferrari' like he's picturing it. Quiet pride in his own hands doing something with Dad's.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが軽井沢のお別荘を借りて下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad's arranged for us to rent a cottage in Karuizawa.
lines.style: Warm anticipation. Gentle opening. A slight lift of excitement underneath — she's sharing something she knows will please him. Thoughtful pace, letting each word land.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとお庭で野菜の種子を蒔いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I planted vegetable seeds in the garden.
lines.style: Soft contentment. Slower, dreamy pace — he's dwelling in a quiet moment. Pride in the simple act of doing something useful with his dad. Voice trailing softly, almost whispering the memory.
